text:
Corporeal Beast

​
Introduction
The Corporeal Beast is a boss unlocked from completing the Summer's End quest. Summoning familiars cannot be used at this boss, however a legendary pet can be used here.
​
Mechanics

















Mechanics


Auto Attacks
⬥ Only uses magic attacks if you are outside of melee distance.
⬥ Uses magic and melee attacks if you are in melee distance.
    • Protection prayers only partially reduce damage rather than halve it
    • Magic attacks will do an AOE splash on their target in a 3x3 square.
​
Core
⬥ Occasionally, a dark core will spawn and jump towards its target.
⬥ The core will do constant typeless damage while nearby.
    • Damage will stop when you step more than 1 square away.
    • Will heal the boss unless it is killed or you step away from it.
​








​
General
Any weapon that isn't a Spear will deal half damage, so Melee is the recommended style that should be used at this boss.
​
⬥ It Is recommended to teleport out  after every kill to reset Abilities, Health and Prayer.
​
AFK Methods
⬥ AFK methods can be found in #unknown-channel
​
Presets and Relics
⬥ T90 Necro 
⬥ T95-T100 Necro 
⬥ Melee
